selection_rule.definition: enumerate all ABSENT and TEST candidates; select every domain passing every freeze guard, prioritizing TEST over ABSENT only for reporting
selection_rule.reason: The prior after-1IGV tiebreak was arbitrary. Rule 2 requires an actually mapped hard-protection feature, not merely a protein-level annotation.

deviations.trigger: Only 2 of 983 domains had a disulfide and none passed the remaining criteria
deviations.new_criterion: Rule 2: UniProt ACT_SITE, BINDING, METAL, or DISULFID
deviations.rationale: The cDNA-display assay largely excludes disulfide-containing domains
deviations.not_observed: No label or ddG distribution for the selected domain

deviations.original_criterion: Each random fold spans more than 60 mutable positions
deviations.trigger: 2AMI row-random folds covered 59-62 of 62 non-holdout positions
deviations.new_criterion: Each random fold covers at least 90% of non-holdout positions
deviations.rationale: Relative coverage detects position-based defects across domain sizes
deviations.not_observed: No label or ddG distribution for 2AMI

deviations.trigger: 2ROT best window identity was 0.667 with 23 mismatches and an internal indel
deviations.new_criterion: Unique gap-free best window, identity >=0.90, no internal indels, protected-letter match, and no mismatch within +/-1 of protected residues
deviations.rationale: Engineered DMS constructs can differ from UniProt while remaining identifiable; mapped protected residues remain the hard safety check
deviations.not_observed: No label or ddG distribution for any affected candidate
